records.subject: Se substitution at O sites in BiCuSeO
records.object: Dense intragranular lattice dislocations in Pb-doped BiCuSeO
records.quote: Herein, taking BiCuSeO oxide as an example, the present work reports a successful construction of dense lattice dislocations in BiCuSeO by self-doping of Se at the O site (i.e., SeO self-substitution), and achieves plain optimization of the thermoelectric properties with only external Pb doping.
context_quotes: Owing to the self-substitution-induced large lattice distortion and the potential reinforcement effect by Pb doping, high-density (about 3.0 x1014m-2) dislocations form in the grains, which enhances the scattering strength of mid-frequency phonon and results in a substantial low lattice thermal conductivity of 0.38 W m-1 K-1 at 823 K in Pb-doped BiCuSeO.
records.conditions: SeO self-substitution; only external dopant is Pb.

records.quote: Cyclic voltammetry and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy were used to investigate the deposition of antimony telluride or copper telluride from ionic liquid consisting in mixture of choline chloride with oxalic acid.
context_quotes: Thin films were deposited on copper and carbon steel at 60-70 degrees C and were characterised by scanning electron microscopy, energy X-ray dispersive spectroscopy (EDS), and X-ray diffraction (XRD).
modality_evidence: Thin films were deposited on copper and carbon steel at 60-70 degrees C and were characterised by scanning electron microscopy, energy X-ray dispersive spectroscopy (EDS), and X-ray diffraction (XRD).
